topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: OpenCode /auto does not start orchestrator plugin dispatch (ends at command STOP).
environment: OpenCode host with .opencode/ pack installed; .opencode/commands/auto.md; .opencode/plugins/orchestrator.ts; operator invoked /auto correctly.
NOT covered by US-0131/US-0132 (those are config/model parity). Distinct from BUG-0006 (Cursor orchestrator phase-in-band), BUG-0012 (native chain stop).
expected: After /auto, plugin owns spawn and starts the phase→role chain (spawnPhase / stop-matrix) so lifecycle advances (or fails closed with documented OPENCODE_* reason code).
actual: Thin command stops at STOP; plugin exports spawnPhase in setup() return API but does not wire a command/event hook that invokes the spawn loop on /auto.

duplicate_check_notes: Distinct from BUG-0006, BUG-0012, US-0124/US-0125 compose gap (runtime linkage), US-0131/US-0132 OPEN config/model stories.
decomposition_rationale: Bug A = /auto dispatch wiring; Bug B = Layer-1 permission matrix vs kit duties. Separate independently testable defects.
